topic.title: What if Mexico and Spain swapped places?
topic.map_answer: Mexico's own outline laid on Spain at true scale: it covers almost all of Spain and most of Portugal, then reaches across the Mediterranean onto Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia; Spain dropped into Mexico sits almost wholly inside it

shape.name: The swap
shape.beats: hook: Mexico lifted off the Americas and the claim -> Spain's size on a sign -> Mexico lands on Spain and covers Spain and Portugal, spilling into the Atlantic -> Mexico's size and how many Spains -> the other way: Spain dropped into Mexico, a patch inside it -> the people: Spain's count, then Mexico's, and how few times more -> the turn: where Mexico's tail points -> payoff: it crosses the sea onto another continent, Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia -> a pick-one question -> loop back to Mexico lifting off
shape.why: a what-if whose answer is two shapes at true scale: each country lifted and laid on the other's place, so the size gap is seen on the map
